Every fact in the atlas carries a source and a check date, and missing
information is shown as missing rather than guessed. To correct or add a
fact we need the same two things from you: **where it is published** and
**when you checked**.

## Garden

Name (as in the atlas):

## What is wrong or missing

Which fact: description / category or tags / access / opening hours /
entrance (where) / taking part / coordinates / source link / other.

Current text in the atlas (copy it, in either language):

## Correct information

What the source actually says. Please quote or paraphrase it closely; do not
extrapolate (for example, do not turn the hours of a wider site into the
garden's own hours).

## Source

- URL:
- What kind of page it is (official site, operator's rules, district
  magazine, …):
- Date you checked it (YYYY-MM-DD):

## Both languages

If you can, give the text in Czech and in English. If you only know one, say
so and we will translate; the meaning must be identical in both.

## Is the fact publicly verifiable?

Information that exists only in private messages, personal visits or
hearsay cannot be published in the atlas; it needs a public source.
